notes: Make default. Once you have loader values you are happy with, one button makes them the baseline on this machine - they are what Defaults restores to and what survives a config reset.
It promotes what is saved rather than what is typed in the boxes, so a number that was never actually applied and looked at cannot become the default.

Factory sits beside it as the way back to the values the app shipped with. A promoted set becomes the baseline, and some legal values are bad ones - a zero-length loader is allowed and skips the loader entirely - so there needed to be a…
Said plainly on the screen: this sets the baseline on this machine. A fresh install elsewhere still starts on the values built into the app.
